items.title: NTA invites institutions to join its examination-centre network
items.text: India's National Testing Agency has invited schools, colleges, universities and private testing providers to apply to join its examination-centre network for computer-based and pen-and-paper tests. Standard computer-based test centres must have 285 workstations per shift and at least four separate labs or halls with 30 workstations each. Institutions with fewer workstations may also be considered in locations where testing infrastructure is limited. Applications are due by 6 December 2026.

items.title: Armed Forces Medical Services opens applications for 120 medical officers
items.text: The Armed Forces Medical Services opened online applications on 9 November for 120 Short Service Commission Medical Officer vacancies: 90 for male candidates and 30 for female candidates. Eligible Indian citizens with an MBBS degree can apply through the official recruitment portal until 18 November 2026. The selection process includes shortlisting based on NEET PG percentile, an interview, medical examination and document verification.

items.title: Delhi records an AQI of 366 after Diwali celebrations
items.text: Delhi's Air Quality Index stood at 366 at 6:15 am on 9 November, placing the city in the very poor category, according to the CPCB's Sameer app and the Hindustan Times pollution dashboard. The city's average AQI was 376 on Sunday. Monitoring data analysed by Hindustan Times also showed average PM2.5 levels across 39 stations rising from 190 to 259 micrograms per cubic metre around 8 pm on Diwali night.

items.title: Australia leaves Marnus Labuschagne out of its upcoming Test squad
items.text: Australia's selectors confirmed on 9 November that batter Marnus Labuschagne will not be considered for the upcoming four-Test series against New Zealand, which begins on 9 December in Perth. The 32-year-old has not scored a Test century since the 2023 Ashes and has gone 49 innings without a hundred. The decision follows a difficult run of form, including scores of zero and four in the final Test against South Africa.

items.title: IMD expects dry weather across Telangana through 15 November
items.text: The India Meteorological Department's Hyderabad centre forecast dry weather across Telangana from 9 to 15 November 2026 and issued no weather warnings for the seven-day period. Isolated light to moderate rain or thundershowers remained possible during the night of 8 November. The forecast was included in the centre's seven-day outlook and farmer's weather bulletin issued on 8 November.
